cc:Work.dc:title: Target-label sensitivity at common settings
cc:Work.dc:description: Chronological Farm 6 test RMSE as the target fitting-label budget varies; means and ranges over seeds 0, 1, and 2. The source pool, test population, and total domain coefficient masses are fixed.
